description: Overstroming - Overstromingskans primaire en regionale keringen (2020) is a dataset listed in National Georegister of the Netherlands, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by PDOK. Since 2019, the DPRA has been recommending the new map ‘Local Flood Risk’ for the theme Consequence Limitation of Floods. Coverage: NL. The portal shows the English title as "Flooding - Primary and regional flood risk (2020)" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Primaire waterkeringen, Klimaateffectatlas, Overstroming. The listing shows 2020-09-22 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-ngr-nl.
